credit.title: Tensile test of steel specimen using digital image correlation
credit.changes: Camera 1 of the stereo pair only. 41 of the 751 load steps kept (0, 3–30, 35, 40, 45, 55, 80, 130, 205, 305, 405, 509, 605, 705). Each photo cropped to the specimen band, (0, 780)–(2000, 1215), and saved as 8-bit PNG. The force at those steps written to steel_loads.csv (kN), and the gauge points' strain to truth_gauge_strain.csv.
